fields.description: Golf Hills is a residential release at Emaar South, with one to three bedroom apartments and six three bedroom townhouses. The homes face a landscaped, golf-oriented setting with pool and fitness spaces. This record covers Golf Hills itself; Golf Hills 2 is a separate release in the catalogue.

overview: Golf Hills uses a restrained material palette of timber, textured stone, metal and glass. The brochure presents large windows and connected living spaces as a way to bring the landscape into the home. Shared recreation centres on the pool, gym, yoga and padel facilities, with separate places for children and informal gatherings. Emaar South’s wider master plan includes retail, healthcare, education and hospitality; these community proposals are distinct from facilities delivered inside the building. Golf-course proximity does not establish membership rights or an uninterrupted view from every residence.
research.locationNote: Golf Hills is in Emaar South, within the Dubai South district near Al Maktoum International Airport. The community map shows Emirates Road and the DWC peripheral road around the wider development. Emaar identifies Golf Views, Golf Point and Urbana III nearby. Check the actual route and outlook for the chosen home.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises Golf Hills from AED 1.06m. The phase 1 launch sheet lists two-bedroom apartments from AED 1.51m, three-bedroom apartments from AED 2.83m and townhouses from AED 5.07m. These are advertised or historical starting figures, not a confirmation that a unit remains available at that price.
research.paymentNote: The original schedule is 10% booking, seven further 10% instalments and 20% on estimated completion. The later interim payments are linked to 40%, 60% and 80% construction. Passed instalment dates mean a new purchase needs an updated statement of amounts due.
research.handoverNote: September 2029 is the estimated completion month in the project’s payment sheet, corroborated by Property Finder. Confirm the current programme and contractual delivery terms before reservation.

facts.label: Original phase 1 collection
facts.value: 204 homes: 70 one-bedroom, 101 two-bedroom and 27 three-bedroom apartments, plus six townhouses. This is the launch mix, not live inventory.

facts.label: Townhouse layout
facts.value: The two townhouse types occupy ground and podium levels, with living spaces, a maid’s room, laundry and store below three upstairs bedrooms. Both total 2,197.34 sq ft of suite and 884.15 sq ft of balcony/terrace.

facts.label: Large terraces affect total area
facts.value: Three-bedroom Type 1.1 has 1,579.17 sq ft of suite and 931.51 sq ft of balcony/terrace within its 2,510.68 sq ft total. Compare usable interior space as well as the headline area.
